human translation: According to settled case-law, a measure by which the public authorities grant to certain undertakings a tax exemption which, although not involving a transfer of state resources, places those to whom the tax exemption applies in a more favourable financial situation than other taxpayers constitutes aid granted by the state or through state resources.

human translation: According to Article 4(1) of the Authority's Decision No 195/04/COL on the implementing provisions under Article 27 in Part II of Protocol 3 (the ‘Implementing Decision’), ‘[…] an alteration to existing aid is any change, other than modifications of a purely formal or administrative nature which cannot affect the evaluation of the compatibility of the aid measure with the common market’.
source text: Laut Artikel 4 Absatz 1 der Entscheidung Nr. 195/04/COL der Überwachungsbehörde über die Durchführungsbestimmungen von Teil II Artikel 27 des Protokolls 3 (der „Durchführungsentscheidung“) „[…] gilt als Umgestaltung einer bestehenden Beihilfe jede Änderung, außer einer Änderung rein formaler oder verwaltungstechnischer Art, die keinen Einfluss auf die Würdigung der Vereinbarkeit der Beihilfemaßnahme mit dem Gemeinsamen Markt haben kann“.
claude: According to Article 4(1) of Decision No 195/04/COL of the Surveillance Authority on the implementing provisions of Part II Article 27 of Protocol 3 (the "Implementing Decision"), "[...] any change, other than modifications of a purely formal or administrative nature which cannot affect the evaluation of the compatibility of the aid measure with the common market, shall be considered an alteration to existing aid".
gemini: According to Article 4(1) of Decision No 195/04/COL of the Surveillance Authority on the implementing provisions of Part II of Article 27 of Protocol 3 (the ‘Implementing Decision’), ‘[…] any change, other than a change of a purely formal or administrative nature which cannot affect the assessment of the compatibility of the aid measure with the common market, shall be regarded as an alteration to existing aid’.
gemma: According to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of Decision No. 195/04/COL of the monitoring authority on the implementing provisions of Part II, Article 27 of Protocol 3 (the Implementing Decision) [...] any change, except for a change of purely formal or administrative nature, which has no impact on the assessment of the compatibility of the aid measure with the common market, is deemed to be a restructuring of an existing aid.
llamma: According to Article 4, paragraph 1 of the Decision No 195/04/COL of the Supervisory Body on the implementing provisions of Article 27 of Part II of Protocol 3 (the Implementing Decision)  [...] any alteration of an existing aid is considered to be a restructuring of the aid, except for a change of a formal or administrative nature which cannot have an influence on the assessment of the compatibility of the aid measure with the Common Market.
nllb: According to Article 4 (1) of the Authority's Decision No 195/04/COL on the detailed rules for the implementation of Article 27 of Part II of Protocol 3 (the 'Implementing Decision') [...], any change to an existing aid measure is considered to be a restructuring, except a change of a purely formal or administrative nature which cannot affect the assessment of the compatibility of the aid measure with the common market.
openai: According to Article 4(1) of Decision No 195/04/COL of the Surveillance Authority on the implementing provisions of Part II, Article 27 of Protocol 3 (the “Implementing Decision”), “[…] any change, other than a change of a purely formal or administrative nature which cannot affect the assessment of the compatibility of the aid measure with the common market, shall be considered an alteration to existing aid”.
qwen: According to Article 4 Paragraph 1 of Decision No. 195/04/COL of the Monitoring Authority on the Implementing Regulations for Part II Article 27 of Protocol No. 3 (the Implementing Decision), … a restructuring of an existing assistance is regarded as such any change, other than a formal or administrative technical change, that cannot influence the assessment of the compatibility of the assistance measure with the Common Market.

gemma: In view of the fact that, according to Article 1, letter c, Part II of Protocol 3, changes to existing aid are to be considered as new aid, the question arises as to whether the amended existing aid should be classified as a whole or only the changes as new aid.

gemini: If this is the case, the changes constitute new aid and must therefore be reassessed in light of Article 61(3)(c) and the Surveillance Authority's Guidelines on National Regional Aid for 2007-2013 (the 'Regional Aid Guidelines 2007').

human translation: According to established case-law, an alteration of an existing aid scheme that extends it to a new category of beneficiaries is clearly severable from the initial scheme, since the application of the existing aid scheme to the new category of beneficiaries does not affect the assessment of the compatibility of the initial scheme.

claude: According to established case law, an amendment to an existing aid scheme that extends the scheme to a new category of beneficiaries is clearly separable from the original scheme, since the application of the existing aid scheme to the new category of beneficiaries has no impact on the assessment of the compatibility of the original scheme.

human translation: However, Becromal's understanding of the HGA judgment disregards the express finding of the Court of Justice that the finding of the General Court that: ‘[…] the requirement that the investment project be commenced before the submission of the application for aid is a simple, relevant and suitable criterion enabling the Commission to presume that the planned aid is necessary’ was not called into question in the appeal proceedings.
source text: Becromal lässt bei seiner Auslegung des Urteils in der Sache HGA jedoch die ausdrückliche Meinung des Gerichtshofs außer Acht, „[…] dass die Forderung, dass der Beihilfeantrag dem Beginn der Durchführung der Beihilfe vorausgehen müsse, ein einfaches, sachgerechtes und angemessenes Kriterium sei, das es der Kommission ermögliche, die Notwendigkeit der geplanten Beihilfe zu vermuten“ im Rahmen des Rechtsmittels nicht infrage gestellt wurde.
claude: Becromal, however, in its interpretation of the judgment in the HGA case, disregards the Court's express opinion that "[...] the requirement that the aid application must precede the start of implementation of the aid is a simple, appropriate and proportionate criterion which enables the Commission to presume the necessity of the planned aid" was not challenged in the appeal.
gemini: In its interpretation of the judgment in the HGA case, however, Becromal disregards the Court's express opinion that the finding that '[...] the requirement that the aid application must precede the start of the implementation of the aid is a simple, objective and appropriate criterion enabling the Commission to presume the necessity of the planned aid' was not called into question on appeal.
gemma: Becromal, however, disregards the express opinion of the Court of Justice in his interpretation of the judgment in the case of HGA, […] that the requirement that the application for aid must precede the commencement of the implementation of the aid, is a simple, appropriate and reasonable criterion which enables the Commission to suspect the necessity of the planned aid was not challenged within the framework of the legal remedy.
llamma: Becromal, however, disregards the explicit opinion of the court in its interpretation of the judgment in the case HGA, that [...] the requirement that the aid application must precede the start of the provision of aid is a simple, appropriate and reasonable criterion that enables the Commission to presume the necessity of the planned aid was not disputed in the appeal.
nllb: However, in its interpretation of the HGA judgment, Becromal disregards the express opinion of the Court of Justice that 'the requirement that the aid application must precede the start of the implementation of the aid is a simple, factual and appropriate criterion enabling the Commission to suspect the necessity of the planned aid' has not been challenged in the context of the appeal.

human translation: The Authority therefore takes the view that in this instance it is appropriate to base its finding of incompatibility on a chronological assessment: namely that: (i) the incentive test set out in the 2007 RAG was not met; and (ii) work started on the project before the conclusion of the Investment Agreement and the grant of the aid.
source text: Die Überwachungsbehörde vertritt daher die Ansicht, dass es in diesem Fall angemessen ist, die Feststellung der Unvereinbarkeit auf einen zeitlichen Ablauf zu stützen, nämlich dass i) die in den Regionalbeihilfeleitlinien 2007 vorgeschriebene Prüfung des Anreizeffekts nicht erfüllt wurde und ii) die Arbeiten an dem Vorhaben bereits vor Abschluss der Investitionsvereinbarung und vor Gewährung der Beihilfe aufgenommen wurden.
claude: The Surveillance Authority therefore takes the view that in this case it is appropriate to base the finding of incompatibility on a temporal sequence, namely that i) the examination of the incentive effect prescribed in the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines was not fulfilled and ii) work on the project had already commenced before the conclusion of the investment agreement and before the aid was granted.
gemini: The Supervisory Authority therefore takes the view that it is appropriate in this case to base the finding of incompatibility on a sequence of events, namely that i) the examination of the incentive effect prescribed in the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines was not carried out and ii) work on the project had already commenced before the investment agreement was concluded and before the aid was granted.

qwen: Therefore, the supervisory authority holds the view that it is appropriate to base the determination of incompatibility on a temporal framework, namely that i) the examination of the incentive effect as prescribed by the Regional Assistance Guidelines 2007 was not fulfilled and ii) the work on the project had already been undertaken prior to the conclusion of the investment agreement and the provision of the grant.

human translation: The Authority notes that for certain large investment projects, the incentive effect test set out in paragraph 30 of the 2007 RAG (based on the chronological requirement that an application has been made and eligibility has been confirmed before work begins) is supplemented by a second test, which is economic in nature (based on an economic analysis that the aid contributes to the changing of the behaviour of the aid beneficiary), provided for in paragraph 57 of the RAG and the LIP Guidelines.
source text: Die Überwachungsbehörde gibt an, dass bei bestimmten großen Investitionsvorhaben die Prüfung des Anreizeffekts gemäß Punkt 30 der Regionalbeihilfeleitlinien 2007 (auf Grundlage der chronologischen Anforderung, dass zunächst ein Beihilfeantrag eingereicht und die Förderfähigkeit festgestellt wurde, bevor mit den Arbeiten begonnen wird) durch eine zweite Prüfung wirtschaftlicher Natur (auf Grundlage einer wirtschaftlichen Analyse in Bezug auf den Beitrag der Beihilfe zu einer Änderung des Verhaltens des Beihilfeempfängers) gemäß Punkt 57 der Regionalbeihilfeleitlinien 2007 und den LIP-Leitlinien ergänzt wird.
claude: The supervisory authority states that for certain large investment projects, the examination of the incentive effect pursuant to point 30 of the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines (based on the chronological requirement that an aid application must first be submitted and eligibility established before work begins) is supplemented by a second examination of an economic nature (based on an economic analysis regarding the contribution of the aid to a change in the beneficiary's behavior) pursuant to point 57 of the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines and the LIP Guidelines.
gemini: The Surveillance Authority states that for certain large investment projects, the assessment of the incentive effect in accordance with point 30 of the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines (based on the chronological requirement that an application for aid is submitted and eligibility is established before work begins) is supplemented by a second, economic assessment (based on an economic analysis of the contribution of the aid to a change in the aid beneficiary's behaviour) in accordance with point 57 of the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines and the LIP Guidelines.
gemma: The supervisory authority states that for certain large investment projects, the examination of the incentive effect in accordance with point 30 of the Regional Aid Guidelines 2007 (on the basis of the chronological requirement that a grant application must first be submitted and the eligibility for aid determined before work begins) is to be supplemented by a second economic examination (on the basis of an economic analysis of the contribution of the aid to a change in the behaviour of the aid recipient) in accordance with point 57 of the Regional Aid Guidelines 2007 and the LIP Guidelines.

nllb: The Authority notes that for certain large investment projects, the incentive effect test under point 30 of the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines (based on the chronological requirement that an aid application has first been submitted and eligibility has been determined before work starts) is complemented by a second economic nature test (based on an economic analysis of the aid's contribution to a change in the behaviour of the aid beneficiary) under point 57 of the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines and the LIP Guidelines.

qwen: The oversight authority states that for certain large investment projects, the examination of the incentive effect according to Article 30 of the Regional Assistance Guidelines 2007 (based on a chronological requirement that an assistance application be submitted first and the eligibility for assistance determined before work begins) is supplemented by a second economic assessment (based on an economic analysis regarding the impact of the assistance on the beneficiarys behavior) according to Article 57 of the Regional Assistance Guidelines 2007 and the LIP guidelines.

claude: Consequently, according to applicable case law and according to the wording of the 2007 Regional Aid Guidelines, it is sufficient to establish whether the aid recipient has submitted an aid application; furthermore, the competent authority must confirm the measure in writing before work begins, but the aid is subject to approval by the monitoring authority.

human translation: The Authority cannot accept Becromal's argument that the ‘start of work’ should be confined to the ordering of equipment specially designed for the given project, and that the purchase of land and/or the building of a plant does not necessarily mark the beginning of an investment decision since such investment could easily be sold at any given time.

source text: Becromal invoque l'arrêt de la Cour de justice dans l'affaire HGA pour soutenir que: «[…] la Cour, dans son réexamen de l'arrêt du Tribunal de première instance, a jugé que le seul facteur déterminé quant à savoir si la mesure d'aide a eu un effet incitatif consistait à examiner si elle avait modifié le comportement de l'investisseur et a écarté toutes les références que le Tribunal de première instance avait faites à l'affaire Kronoply».

claude: However, Becromal's interpretation of the HGA judgment does not take into account the fact that the Court of Justice expressly found that the General Court's conclusion that "[...] the fact that the application for aid precedes the start of implementation of the investment project constitutes a simple, relevant and appropriate criterion enabling the Commission to presume that the planned aid is necessary" was not challenged in the appeal.

source text: La definición de ayuda es más general que la de subvención, ya que comprende no solo las prestaciones positivas, como las subvenciones propiamente dichas, sino también las intervenciones estatales que, bajo diversas formas, alivian las cargas que normalmente recaen sobre el presupuesto de una empresa y, por ello, sin ser subvenciones en el sentido estricto de la palabra, tienen un carácter similar y producen el mismo efecto.
